10K reactions · 479 shares | The tiger lay stretched out in the tall grass, nearly invisible, its stripes blending perfectly with the golden shadows. The air was heavy and still, disturbed only by the distant hum of insects.

Then — crack.

A sharp, sudden sound.

In a fraction of a second, the tiger sprang up. Its ears snapped forward, muscles tightening like coiled springs. Its amber eyes locked onto a single point in the trembling grass.

Something was there.

Slowly, almost imperceptibly, a shape emerged. A young antelope, inexperienced, stepping cautiously, unaware of the danger. It paused, startled by the very sound it had made when it snapped a dry twig beneath its hoof.

The tiger didn’t move. It watched.
